correctness.rationale: Exact partition of ordered arclength pairs produces identity (1), independently checked by simulation. Pairwise smoothing changes the integral by -2(L-s) times the pairwise length product, so strict equal arms; the remaining cubic has a unique interior minimum for each integer k, with explicit quadratic root and correct boundary signs. Radical expansion and monotonicity checked algebraically. Experiments support rather than prove infinite k.

value.rationale: Natural complete constrained network design classification for every number of terminal corridors: proves all-edge balancing, unique positive cycle/stem allocation, sharp one-arm 17/75 benchmark, and a nontrivial k-dependent asymptotic transition with mean distance asymptotic L/k. The known global flower theorem cannot replace this result, and the optimal positive loop is counterintuitive against a pure star of the same total length.
